0x007C228E.name: g_modelPartNameFormat
0x007C228E.comment: Builds the per-part resource prefix ("sp" + part id) for the 47x6 part loop of BattleScene_BindUnitModelResources; the result is then fed to the %s.ani / %s.bxon / %s.bch formats below.

0x007C2293.name: g_aniFileSuffixFormat
0x007C2293.comment: Appends the animation-resource extension: "%s.ani" turns the part prefix into the animation file name loaded from the battle archive.

0x007C229A.name: g_bxonFileSuffixFormat
0x007C229A.comment: Appends the .bxon extension (binary object/animation container) when building the part's resource path.

0x007C22A2.name: g_bchFileSuffixFormat
0x007C22A2.comment: Appends the .bch model extension when building the part's model resource path.

0x007C22C4.name: g_modelPartNameFormatB
0x007C22C4.comment: Second copy of the part-name format, used by the extra pass that BattleScene_BindUnitModelResources runs for unit id 400 (the 'm210b' row).

0x007C22C9.name: g_aniFileSuffixFormatB
0x007C22C9.comment: Second copy of the animation-file format, used by the unit-400 extra pass of BattleScene_BindUnitModelResources.

0x007C22D0.name: g_bxonFileSuffixFormatB
0x007C22D0.comment: Second copy of the .bxon format, used by the unit-400 extra pass of BattleScene_BindUnitModelResources.

0x007C22D8.name: g_bchFileSuffixFormatB
0x007C22D8.comment: Second copy of the .bch format, used by the unit-400 extra pass of BattleScene_BindUnitModelResources.

0x007C33D4.name: g_actorBaseClass
0x007C33D4.comment: Static class-descriptor (type-info node) of the engine's base actor class: the class that PlayerBattleActor, EnemyBattleActor and AttachVehicleActor3D register as their parent. About 130 functions walk an object's class chain until they hit this node to prove 'this is an actor' before reading its transform at +0x9C..+0xA4, so do not read the 4 bytes as a plain integer.

0x007C428C.name: g_enemyBattleActorClass
0x007C428C.comment: Static class-descriptor of the battle enemy-actor class 'EnemyBattleActor' (parent = g_actorBaseClass). Battle UI/action code uses it as the type test that selects enemy actor objects; the same static initialiser also seeds the default UI palette at 0x7A3744.

0x007C42A0.name: g_enemyBattleActorNizuzerufaClass
0x007C42A0.comment: Static class-descriptor of the enemy battle-actor subclass registered as 'EnemyBattleActor_Nizuzerufa' (parent = g_enemyBattleActorClass). Battle effect/action code uses it as the type test for that boss's actor before forwarding effects to it.

0x007C4304.name: maybe_g_actorDisplayOffset
0x007C4304.comment: Three-float offset added to battle actor/effect placement: the EnemyDesertWhale class registration seeds it with (0, 0, -6.5), and maybe_Battle_CameraRangeBlend_Update adds its components to the positions it computes and copies them into the sprite/effect child it creates (child+0x31C/0x320/0x324). The object lives in BSS, so the retail image holds no value to read - the numbers come from that reg

0x007C4E14.name: g_attachVehicleActor3DClass
0x007C4E14.comment: Static class-descriptor of the field actor class 'AttachVehicleActor3D' (parent = g_actorBaseClass). The battle action-UI handle resolver uses it to accept only objects of that class.

0x007C5014.name: g_playerBattleActorClass
0x007C5014.comment: Static class-descriptor of the battle player-actor class 'PlayerBattleActor' (parent = g_actorBaseClass), i.e. the type test for a party member's battle actor.

0x007C5120.name: g_battleLayoutOrigin
0x007C5120.comment: Battle layout origin as three floats: maybe_BattleScene_LayoutUnitModel_2 places units on a line at 'origin.y' (it copies word +0x4 straight into the unit's f_a0) while x/z are computed from the unit index. The layout initialiser zeroes the whole entry.

0x007C512C.name: g_battleEntryPosition
0x007C512C.comment: Three-float position where a unit is put at the start of the battle slide-in: BattleScene_ApplyUnitSlideTransform copies it into the model node's f_9c/f_a0/f_a4 for the step==1 / index==0 case (all other cases slide along a circle).

0x007C5138.name: g_battleUnitSlotPos2
0x007C5138.comment: Three-float (x, 0, z) battle position of unit-layout slot 2 (-5.4, 0, -2.33): the index==2 branch of BattleScene_ApplyUnitSlotTransform copies it into the model node's f_9c/f_a0/f_a4. Filled with that default by the battle layout initialiser.

0x007C5144.name: g_battleUnitSlotPos1
0x007C5144.comment: Three-float (x, 0, z) battle position of unit-layout slot 1 (5.48, 0, -2.32): the index==1 branch of BattleScene_ApplyUnitSlotTransform copies it into the model node's f_9c/f_a0/f_a4. Filled with that default by the battle layout initialiser.

0x007C5150.name: g_battleUnitSlotPos0
0x007C5150.comment: Three-float (x, 0, z) battle position of unit-layout slot 0 (-3.51, 0, 4.66): the index==0 branch of BattleScene_ApplyUnitSlotTransform copies it into the model node's f_9c/f_a0/f_a4. Filled with that default by the battle layout initialiser.

0x007C515C.name: g_battleUnitSlotPos3
0x007C515C.comment: Three-float (x, 0, z) battle position of unit-layout slot 3 (3.52, 0, 4.62): the index==3 branch of BattleScene_ApplyUnitSlotTransform copies it into the model node's f_9c/f_a0/f_a4. Filled with that default by the battle layout initialiser.

0x007C5168.name: g_battleUnitSlotPos4
0x007C5168.comment: Three-float (x, 0, z) battle position of unit-layout slot 4 (0, 0, 7.24), the front-centre slot: the index==4 branch of BattleScene_ApplyUnitSlotTransform copies it into the model node's f_9c/f_a0/f_a4, and maybe_BattleScene_LayoutPartyUnits_Tail reads it too.

0x007C5180.name: maybe_g_battleScrollOffsetTable
0x007C5180.comment: Eight (min, max) float pairs read by maybe_Battle_Ui_UpdateScrollAnimation: entry i is fetched at +i*8 as the start/end of the scroll offset for the current item count. The same block is also written with six palette words by the static colour initialiser Field_InitActorColorTable_7A5C74, so only the float-table reading is backed by live code.

0x007C8578.name: maybe_g_actorListNodePoolTail
0x007C8578.comment: Last node of the static actor-list node pool that Field_InitActorListNodePool builds: it chains the six 0x58-byte nodes at 0x7C83B4..0x7C8578 and resets this one, and every node's first word is the shared node descriptor 0x781064. The 8 visible bytes are the node's two list words.

0x007E2164.name: maybe_g_modelClass
0x007E2164.comment: Static class-descriptor (type-info node) of the loaded model/animation instance class: every resource loader validates the object returned by the archive lookup by walking its class chain to this node before binding it, and maybe_Class_IsInstanceOf is the shared 'return it only if it is a model' helper.

0x007E700C.name: maybe_g_defaultBasisVector2
0x007E700C.comment: Second of the five consecutive 12-byte (3-float) default-vector entries at 0x7E7000..0x7E703C that object constructors copy into new transforms; math and effect code reads it, often negated, as a box/billboard axis. The exact axis (up / forward / scale) is not verified.

0x007275DC.name: g_bg2dLayerPageSearchOrder
0x007275DC.comment: Search order for the four Bg2D layer texture pages (2x u8[4]): bytes 4..7 are each layer's first-choice page id (3,0,1,2), bytes 0..3 are a successor ring (0->1->2->3->0) walked by Bg2D_ResolveLayerTextures when that page is missing from the '2d_bg/%d' resource. It only picks the page slot; the u16 texture ids land in the Bg2DScene layer at +0x62/+0x64.

0x007272A4.name: g_cameraTargetFilterAll
0x007272A4.comment: Option bytes handed to Camera_IsCandidateVisible: byte 0 also rejects candidates whose hidden flag is set, byte 1 also rejects candidates farther away than their own radius. Both are 1 here (bytes 01 01 00 00), so Camera_BuildVisibleTargetLists applies every filter; the recovered code only reads bytes 0-1.

0x007272A8.name: g_cameraTargetFilterNoRadius
0x007272A8.comment: Same option pair as g_cameraTargetFilterAll but byte 1 is 0, so only the hidden-flag test runs and the distance/radius test is skipped. maybe_Camera_UpdateTargetList passes it while re-validating an actor-derived camera target (bytes 01 00 FF FF).

0x007731C8.name: g_battleCameraRangeVtable
0x007731C8.comment: Vtable installed by the 0x50-byte battle-camera range object built by the constructor at 0x0046E8B8 (called from maybe_Field_SetEncounterParams next to the 'shortRange'/'battle' range names). Word 0 is the null complete-destructor slot, word 1 the first virtual 0x0046E8D0, word 7 the class's own override 0x0046E7F4, and from word 8 on the slots are the shared scene-object base tail.

0x0077B190.name: g_battleCameraRangeVtableB
0x0077B190.comment: Sibling battle-camera range vtable of the same 24-word shape, installed by the constructor at 0x004E5B3C, which also seeds a 0.6/0.8 blend pair at +0x48/+0x4C of the object. Both constructors are used by maybe_Field_SetEncounterParams and maybe_Battle_CameraRangeBlend_Update for the different 'battle'/'shortRange' range variants.

0x0077D85C.name: g_cameraShakeWorkVtable
0x0077D85C.comment: Vtable (4 words) of the 0x94-byte camera-shake work registered under the name 'ReguralyShake': word 0 null, word 1 the deleting destructor 0x00591374, word 2 Camera_RegularShake_Update, word 3 0x00591194. Installed both by Camera_RegularShake_Ctor and by the allocating helper maybe_Camera_CreateRegularShakeWork.

0x007A6050.name: g_cameraManualYawSpeed
0x007A6050.comment: Pad-yaw speed: Camera_UpdateManualYaw multiplies the stick yaw delta by this before adding it to the camera yaw (retail 100.0). The same address is also used as a base pointer by maybe_Ui_ScreenChild_EffectObject_Ctor, which reads the following 0.0f word, so 0x7A6050 heads a shared defaults area rather than a camera-only constant.

0x007A6058.name: maybe_g_cameraOccludedHeightOffset
0x007A6058.comment: Target value for the camera's vertical collision offset f_268 in Camera_ResolveCollision on the branch that uses the stored collision history; the offset then eases toward it at the fixed 0.3 rate (constant 0x3E99999A at literal 0x004417DC). Retail value 0.0, so the offset is driven to zero.

0x007A605C.name: maybe_g_cameraBoomDecay
0x007A605C.comment: Per-frame decay applied to the camera boom length f_15c at the end of Camera_ResolveCollision (f_15c -= f_15c * k). Retail value 0.0, i.e. the retail build leaves the boom length unchanged.

0x007A6060.name: maybe_g_cameraBoomLerpA
0x007A6060.comment: Ease rate for the boom length f_158 in Camera_ResolveCollision on the branch where the stored collision-history entry is valid. Retail 0.0 means the boom snaps straight to the measured distance.

0x007A6064.name: maybe_g_cameraBoomLerpB
0x007A6064.comment: Ease rate for the boom length f_158 on the opposite branch of Camera_ResolveCollision (no valid history entry); retail 0.0. The pair 0x7A6060/0x7A6064 lets the game smooth the boom differently for the two occlusion cases.

0x007A6068.name: g_cameraAutoYawGain
0x007A6068.comment: Gain applied to the per-frame yaw delta in Camera_Update's auto/gyro camera branch, after the delta is converted to degrees (x57.29578) and before the 1/360 turn normalisation. Retail 0.0, so the retail build produces no auto yaw.

0x007A606C.name: g_cameraAutoYawMaxDegrees
0x007A606C.comment: Upper bound, in degrees per frame, on how far the auto/gyro camera may turn at once: Camera_Update clamps the computed angle to this value times 0.0174533 (deg->rad) before applying the yaw gain. Retail 0.0 clamps the auto turn to zero.

0x007A6070.name: g_cameraTargetEyeScale
0x007A6070.comment: Scale of the last camera transition target (Camera.f_108), published by Camera_SetTransitionTarget and read back by Camera_UpdateTransition when it restores a stored pose without a running transition. Written on every transition start, so a modder can read the current boom scale from it.

0x007A6074.name: g_cameraTargetEyeDistance
0x007A6074.comment: Distance of the last camera transition eye position from the world origin (sqrt of the new eye vector), published by Camera_SetTransitionTarget and used by Camera_UpdateTransition to rebuild the eye as direction * distance. Starts at 0.0 and is rewritten on every transition.

0x007A6078.name: maybe_g_cameraSetupAngleDegrees
0x007A6078.comment: Published camera angle in degrees: Camera_SetupFromActor writes self->f_114 (radians) times 57.29578 here. No reader was recovered, so this is a one-way export of the angle the camera was set up with; retail value 0.0.

0x007A6148.name: maybe_g_defaultCameraParam
0x007A6148.comment: Default float copied into Camera+0x28 by maybe_Camera_InitOrbitParams (camera constructor path) and into UiModelView f_100/f_104/f_108 by maybe_Ui_ModelView_SetCharacterText. It is 0.0f and the same word is reused for both a camera orbit value and the three model-view defaults, so read it as a shared default scalar, not a live setting.

0x007A6184.name: maybe_g_cameraStereoRollDegrees
0x007A6184.comment: Roll angle in degrees used by maybe_Camera_UpdateStereoSmoothing: it is scaled by 0.01745329 (deg->rad) and stored in Camera.f_28, next to the axis vector taken from 0x7A6180 into f_1c/f_20/f_24. Retail 0.0 (no stereo roll).

0x007A63E1.name: maybe_g_cameraPathProbeFlag
0x007A63E1.comment: Byte switch in maybe_Camera_UpdateWorkPathEx: when non-zero, a successful sprite/occlusion test is followed by an extra Gfx_Scene_FindEntriesAlongLine probe and the probe point is shifted by the hit result. Retail value 0, so that extra probe is present but switched off.

0x007A63E4.name: g_cameraPathInitGuard
0x007A63E4.comment: Static-initialisation guard word at +0xC of the 0x7A63D8 camera-path block. maybe_Camera_UpdateWorkPathEx tests bit 0 and, while it is clear, calls func_0010009C (= __cxa_guard_acquire at 0x0010009C) with this address; the lazy initialiser that would set it is not visible in the recovered code.

0x007A6428.name: g_nullWorkEntry
0x007A6428.comment: Zero-filled 'null object' (0x88 bytes) that stands in for a missing per-screen work-entry detail pointer: camera, UI row-layout, field-NPC, battle and screen-view code all do 'if (entry->f_10c == 0) use &g_nullWorkEntry' and then read fields up to +0x84. Because it is all zero every such field reads as 0/false, so do not write to it.

0x007A64B0.name: g_nullCameraWork
0x007A64B0.comment: Second zero-filled null object, used where a camera-work pointer is 0 (target finding, work list, work-path update and both view-transform builders). Fields read on it are +0x20/+0x24 (target weights), +0x3C (float), +0x48 (u16), +0x4A/+0x4B (bytes) and +0x54 (id).

0x007A8B80.name: g_distanceScaleConfig
0x007A8B80.comment: Base of the 0x28-byte distance-scale config used by maybe_Camera_ComputeDistanceScale to shrink billboards/overlays with distance: byte +0 enables the distance test, byte +1 enables the second test, floats at +8/+0xC are a distance pair, +0x10/+0x14 the max/min output scale, +0x18/+0x1C a second distance pair and +0x20/+0x24 its max/min scale. The whole block is zero in the retail image, i.e. the

0x007A8B81.name: g_distanceScaleConfigEnableB
0x007A8B81.comment: Byte +1 of g_distanceScaleConfig: second on/off switch of the distance scaling (the factor built from the object field f_d4). Retail 0, so the second factor is never applied.

0x007A8B8C.name: g_distanceScaleConfigFarDistance
0x007A8B8C.comment: Far end of the first distance range at +0xC of g_distanceScaleConfig: distances above it clamp to this value before the output scale is interpolated. Retail 0.0.

0x007A8B90.name: g_distanceScaleConfigMaxScale
0x007A8B90.comment: Maximum output scale at +0x10 of g_distanceScaleConfig; the routine divides the clamped distance by (this - the +0x14 minimum scale). Retail 0.0.

0x007A8B9C.name: g_distanceScaleConfigNearDistanceB
0x007A8B9C.comment: Near end of the second distance range at +0x1C of g_distanceScaleConfig (the range used by the model-width factor); the far end is the float at +0x18. Retail 0.0.

0x007A8BA0.name: g_distanceScaleConfigMaxScaleB
0x007A8BA0.comment: Maximum output scale at +0x20 of g_distanceScaleConfig for the second (model-width) factor; the minimum is at +0x24. Retail 0.0.

0x007C51C0.name: g_cameraTransitionTarget
0x007C51C0.comment: World-space look-at target (x,y,z) of the last camera transition, written by Camera_SetTransitionTarget and re-read by Camera_UpdateTransition when no transition is active so the camera can restore its target. Zero until the first transition.

0x007C51CC.name: maybe_g_cameraAnchorOffsetA
0x007C51CC.comment: First of two zero offset vectors that maybe_Camera_ComputeAnchorPoint rotates by the player's forward quaternion and adds to the anchor position (an actor/screen anchor offset). Zero in the retail image.

0x007C51D8.name: maybe_g_cameraAnchorOffsetB
0x007C51D8.comment: Second zero offset vector added by maybe_Camera_ComputeAnchorPoint after the first one (0x7C51CC); both are rotated by the same quaternion, so they are two anchor offsets in actor-local space.

0x007C51F0.name: g_stereoEyeOffsetLeft
0x007C51F0.comment: Left-eye offset added to the camera eye by Camera_CalcStereoEyePositions (the 3DS parallax shift), together with a base offset three floats earlier and a right-eye offset three floats later. All zero in the retail image.

0x007C5208.name: g_fieldCameraOffset
0x007C5208.comment: Constant world-space offset added to both the eye and the target of the field camera every frame in Camera_Field_Update. Zero in the retail image; setting all three floats shifts the field camera.

0x007C522C.name: maybe_g_cameraProbeOffset
0x007C522C.comment: Offset/direction vector used by maybe_Camera_UpdateWorkPathEx when a sprite or occlusion probe hits: the probe point is moved by this vector times the hit distance, and the same vector seeds the debug sprite position. Zero in the retail image.

0x0072AB4C.name: g_slotReelColumnOffset
0x0072AB4C.comment: Column offset of each of the five slot reels inside one interleaved symbol row. Casino_Slot_PickStopBySymbol reads table[reel] and then looks at strip[row*5 + table[reel]]; in the retail image the five words are the identity 0,1,2,3,4.

0x0072AC78.name: g_slotJackpotDelegate
0x0072AC78.comment: Two-word C++ pointer-to-member-function delegate {function = Ui_Delegate_BindActionB, this-adjust = 0}. Casino_Slot_BuildPayoutSequence copies both words into the +0x10/+0x14 fields of the jackpot node, whose exec Ui_Delegate_Invoke then calls the function.

0x0075E0AC.name: g_slotWinTextLine0Vtable
0x0075E0AC.comment: Method table for line 0 of the slot machine's win-message text. Word +8 is Ui_MessageVoice_UpdateLine0, which starts/reveals the text stream and plays the completion SE; Casino_Slot_BuildPayoutSequence allocates a 0x2F-byte voice node and registers it on animation slot +0x47C.

0x0075E0D4.name: g_slotWinTextLine1Vtable
0x0075E0D4.comment: Method table for line 1 of the slot machine's win-message text (word +8 = Ui_MessageVoice_UpdateLine1). Registered by Casino_Slot_BuildPayoutSequence on animation slot +0x494 with a 0x2F-byte voice node.

0x0075E0FC.name: g_slotWinTextLine2Vtable
0x0075E0FC.comment: Method table for line 2 of the slot machine's win-message text (word +8 = Ui_MessageVoice_UpdateLine2). Registered by Casino_Slot_BuildPayoutSequence on animation slot +0x4AC with a 0x2F-byte voice node.

0x0075E124.name: g_slotWinTextLine3Vtable
0x0075E124.comment: Method table for line 3 of the slot machine's win-message text (word +8 = Ui_MessageVoice_UpdateLine3). Registered by Casino_Slot_BuildPayoutSequence on animation slot +0x4C4 with a 0x2F-byte voice node.

0x0075E14C.name: g_slotWinTextLine4Vtable
0x0075E14C.comment: Method table for the last (line 4) win-message text: word +8 is Ui_MessageVoice_FinishLine4, which releases the voice handle after the final line instead of starting another stream. Registered by Casino_Slot_BuildPayoutSequence on animation slot +0x4DC.

0x00760458.name: g_slotWinTextCycleNodeVtable
0x00760458.comment: Win-text id cycling node: pushes a new string id on the first and 0x49th step, plays the matching SEs and finishes when the text object stops animating (exec maybe_Ui_UpdateTextIdProgression). Added by Casino_Slot_BuildPayoutSequence on animation slot +0x4F4.

0x0076046C.name: g_slotDigitRollNodeVtable
0x0076046C.comment: Five-digit rolling-counter animation node: exec maybe_Ui_DigitRoll_Update scrolls the five payout digits over 0x2E frames and plays a SE at steps 0 and 10. It is the first node added by Casino_Slot_BuildPayoutSequence (animation slot +0x464).

0x00762F88.name: g_slotWinTextLayoutNodeVtable
0x00762F88.comment: Win-message layout node: exec maybe_Ui_TextBuild_Start lays out the up-to-three parts of the message, plays SE 0xE70 when the third part begins and finishes after 50 frames. Registered by Casino_Slot_BuildPayoutSequence on animation slot +0x50C.

0x00762F9C.name: g_slotWinLineANodeVtable
0x00762F9C.comment: Win-line A presentation node: on its first call it hides the spinning symbols, resets the payout rows and evaluates the paylines through Casino_Slot_EvaluateWinLineA, playing a win SE if a line pays; afterwards it runs a two-state counter.

0x00762FB0.name: g_slotWinLineBNodeVtable
0x00762FB0.comment: Win-line B presentation node (row B of the payline evaluation). Same one-shot hide/reset/evaluate pattern as win line A; registered by Casino_Slot_BuildPayoutSequence on animation slot +0x4B8.

0x00762FC4.name: g_slotWinLineCNodeVtable
0x00762FC4.comment: Win-line C presentation node (row C of the payline evaluation). Same one-shot hide/reset/evaluate pattern as win line A; registered by Casino_Slot_BuildPayoutSequence on animation slot +0x4D0.

0x00762FD8.name: g_slotWinLineDNodeVtable
0x00762FD8.comment: Win-line D presentation node (row D / default row of the payline evaluation). Also the default line node that maybe_Ui_SlotWindow_ReelStopSequence appends when no reel case matched.

0x00766008.name: g_slotDisplayScaleNodeVtable
0x00766008.comment: One-shot node that scales the slot display by the payout rank (Casino_Slot_GetPayoutRank returns 0/1/2 mapped to 1/10/100) and finishes immediately. Casino_Slot_BuildPayoutSequence appends it to animation slot +0x464 when the self+0x40 counter was already zero.

0x0076601C.name: g_slotWinTransitionNodeVtable
0x0076601C.comment: Win-presentation transition controller: waits for the message widget, starts cue 0x3A/0x3B, fades the window out and finishes. Casino_Slot_CalcPatternPayout builds it (0x3B bytes, transition object at +0x10) for the special symbol-9 payout.

0x00766030.name: g_slotDelegateNodeVtable
0x00766030.comment: One-shot node that invokes the pointer-to-member-function stored at node+0x10/+0x14 (exec Ui_Delegate_Invoke) and reports done when the call returns. Casino_Slot_BuildPayoutSequence uses it for the jackpot action with g_slotJackpotDelegate.

0x00766044.name: g_slotWinMessageRowsNodeVtable
0x00766044.comment: Win-message row animation node: lays out up to three message rows, starts cue 0x3A/0x3B/0x3C and finishes when the message widget stops animating (exec maybe_Ui_MessageWindow_UpdateRows). Registered by Casino_Slot_BuildPayoutSequence on animation slot +0x518.

0x00766DC4.name: g_casinoSlotVtable
0x00766DC4.comment: Class table of the Casino_Slot object (the 5880-byte slot-machine part that the casino window embeds at +0x11C). Word 0 is 0 and the dispatch slots start at +4: delete stub 0x00394768, maybe_Ui_CounterWidget_SetValue, then Casino_Slot_InitPanes (+0x10), ReleaseEffects (+0x14) and RenderReels (+0x18).

0x00768D2C.name: g_slotPayoutSequenceNodeVtable
0x00768D2C.comment: Credit/payout presentation sequence: at frame 0 it starts the payout animation and its SE, at 0x14 switches the machine to the payout display state, at 0x50 plays the win/lose SE 3 or 4 and rebinds the control, then waits for the payout animation. Node+0x10 is the amount and +0x14 the frame counter.

0x00768D40.name: g_slotReelStopSequenceNodeVtable
0x00768D40.comment: Reel-stop sequence: writes the reel result, plays the stop SE and after 0x29 frames attaches the per-line result object for the reel selected by machine+0x53. Node+0x10 is the frame counter; registered by Casino_Slot_BuildPayoutSequence on animation slot +0x500.

0x00768D54.name: g_slotMachineStateNodeVtable
0x00768D54.comment: One-shot slot-machine command: refreshes the payout display from map state, copies the request flags into Casino_Slot+0x171/+0x173 and advances the machine to state 8. It is the last node Casino_Slot_BuildPayoutSequence registers (animation slot +0x560) and has no data fields of its own.

0x00768D68.name: g_slotDisplayByte173NodeVtable
0x00768D68.comment: One-shot node that writes its byte at +0x10 into Casino_Slot+0x173 (one of the two bet/credit digit fields) and finishes. Casino_Slot_BuildPayoutSequence creates it with the decremented self+0x40 counter; maybe_Ui_SlotMachine_ExecState refreshes the same field from self+0x40.

0x0076B7B8.name: g_slotDisplayByte171NodeVtable
0x0076B7B8.comment: One-shot node that writes its byte at +0x10 into Casino_Slot+0x171 (the other bet/credit digit field) and finishes. Casino_Slot_BuildPayoutSequence creates it with the decremented self+0x3C counter; maybe_Ui_SlotMachine_ExecState refreshes the same field from self+0x3C.

0x0076B7CC.name: g_slotWidgetPollNodeVtable
0x0076B7CC.comment: Short poll node: increments its +0x10 counter and finishes after 5 frames or as soon as the slot widget at Casino_Slot+0x56C reports the expected state bits. Used by Casino_Slot_BuildPayoutSequence before the win text (animation slot +0x470).

0x0076E2AC.name: g_slotPayoutCounterNodeVtable
0x0076E2AC.comment: Payout count-up animation node: snapshots the medal counter, interpolates the seven gauge segments toward the new total and plays the coin SE until the value is reached (exec Ui_SlotWindow_UpdatePayoutAnim). Its fields are +0x10 state, +0x18 snapshot, +0x1C running flag and +0x1D gauge-started flag.

0x00771B24.name: g_slotWinSequenceNodeVtable
0x00771B24.comment: Long slot win-result timeline: at frame 0x14 it stops all reels and applies the row state, at 0x19/0x1E/0x23/0x28/0x2D it sets the five reel states, at 0x64 it starts win state 6 or 7 with the amount from +0x10, then waits for the widget and finishes. Built by Casino_Slot_CalcPatternPayout for symbol 8 (animation slot +0x530).

0x00776084.name: g_casinoSlotDisplayVtable
0x00776084.comment: Class vtable of the casino slot display / digit-panel object installed by Casino_SlotMachine_DigitPanel_Ctor. Slots +0/+4 are the deleting/non-deleting destructor, +8 Ui_Widget_ReleaseSub, +0x24 maybe_Casino_Slot_UpdateSpinState; the 0x100-byte objects hold eight 0x10-byte digit colour groups at +0x20..+0xFF.

0x0077A2B8.name: g_casinoPokerWindowVtable
0x0077A2B8.comment: Class vtable of Casino_PokerWindow (the 560-byte poker window): +0 Casino_PokerWindow_DtorBase, +4 Casino_PokerWindow_Dtor (deleting), then the shared Ui_Widget virtuals, +0x20 Ui_PokerScoreList_Init and +0x24 the list row animation. Installed by the poker window constructor and restored by both destructors.

0x007AA048.name: g_casinoSlotDetachedObjectNames
0x007AA048.comment: Three layout-object names that Casino_Slot_InitPanes looks up and detaches at start-up: "win_talk", "win_yesno" and "coinget". The slot machine does not use those three sub-objects, they are leftovers of the shared casino layout.

0x007AA158.name: g_slotDigitLightAnimNames
0x007AA158.comment: Animation names "light_l", "light_c" and "light_r" played while the slot digit counter steps: maybe_Casino_Slot_StepDigitAnim indexes this table with the current digit index (index-1 when counting down) and plays the clip on the digit panel.

0x007C22FC.name: g_slotShuffleInitFlag
0x007C22FC.comment: Once-only guard byte for the function-local static shuffle state g_slotShuffleState used by Casino_Slot_PickStopBySymbol: bit 0 becomes set after the 54-entry permutation table has been built. It is 0 in the retail image and lives in .data.

0x00839800.name: g_slotShuffleState
0x00839800.comment: 228-byte BSS state of the function-local static shuffle used by Casino_Slot_PickStopBySymbol: a 54-entry (0x36) permutation table at +0, the seed/step word at +0xD8 and the two LCG words at +0xDC/+0xE0. It is built on first use behind g_slotShuffleInitFlag.

0x0072863C.name: g_smithSequenceStateCallbacks
0x0072863C.comment: Callback transition table for the Fun-Size Forge (Smith) sequence; each entry is a pair {void (*func)(void), void *ctx} advancing from FindByType to StartSequence, UpdateHitEffect, and ReleaseByType.

0x00729B80.name: g_sortListWindowItemDelegates
0x00729B80.comment: Pointer-to-member-function delegate table for Ui_SortListWindow / Ui_EquipWindow; pairs {code *fn, u32 adj} dispatching row selection, cursor movement, and equipment slot checks.

0x0072B3AC.name: maybe_g_nullListDescriptor
0x0072B3AC.comment: Two-word zero constant {0, 0} loaded by maybe_Container_List_InitAt5C to clear or initialize a double-linked node pointer pair at offset +0x6C.

0x0075A6C8.name: g_rowListObjectVtable
0x0075A6C8.comment: Virtual method table installed into the primary vptr of RowList/Container objects by maybe_Container_CreateObject.

0x0075A6F4.name: g_rowListPresentVtable
0x0075A6F4.comment: Virtual method table for the presentation / layout sub-component of RowList/StringMap containers; contains methods for page drawing and child layout rendering.

0x0075BB68.name: g_menuCampVtable
0x0075BB68.comment: Virtual method table for the Camp menu (Menu_Camp) slot interface; methods handle camp slot status, visibility, readiness, and parameter dispatching.

0x0075E274.name: g_uiPagerWindowVtable
0x0075E274.comment: Virtual method table for Ui_PagerWindow / widget paging container; dispatches page number initialization, child pane visibility animations, and widget release.

0x0075E90C.name: g_uiIntrusiveListWidgetVtable
0x0075E90C.comment: Virtual method table for intrusive list UI widget; installed by Container_IntrusiveList_Dtor during object teardown.

0x0075E9A4.name: g_containerList3Vtable
0x0075E9A4.comment: Virtual destructor table for 3-element container lists; installed by maybe_Container_List3_Dtor during list destruction.

0x0075E9B4.name: g_containerList15Vtable
0x0075E9B4.comment: Virtual destructor table for 15-element container lists; installed by maybe_Container_List15_Dtor during list destruction.

0x00760550.name: g_containerListPairBaseVtable
0x00760550.comment: Base virtual method table for Container_ListPair; restored by maybe_Container_InitListPair during sub-list teardown.

0x007610D4.name: g_containerNameHashBaseVtable
0x007610D4.comment: Base virtual method table for Container_NameHash objects; installed by Container_NameHash_Ctor with pure virtual sentinel.

0x0076111C.name: g_containerNameHashVtable
0x0076111C.comment: Full virtual method table for Container_NameHash; recorded in structs.json as the definitive class vtable.

0x00762E34.name: g_containerNamedLinkNodeVtable
0x00762E34.comment: Virtual method table for named linked container nodes; holds destructor and link-by-name methods.

0x0076334C.name: g_uiObjectBaseVtable
0x0076334C.comment: Base virtual method table for UI objects and container nodes; restored by maybe_Ui_Object_Dtor and node destructor variants.

0x0076BA90.name: g_uiNodeListMenuHandlerVtable
0x0076BA90.comment: Virtual method table for the menu display handler node created by maybe_Container_NodeList_Init; methods ensure menu display state and check battle action readiness.

0x0076E1B0.name: g_stringMapWidgetVtable
0x0076E1B0.comment: Virtual method table for string-map widget component; installed by maybe_Container_StringMap_Ctor at sub-object offset +0xA8.

0x0076FF14.name: g_uiHandleListWindowVtable

0x00782668.name: g_osThreadObjectVtable
0x00782668.comment: Virtual method table for Os_ThreadObject in .rodata; slot 0 points to deleting destructor Os_ThreadObject_Dtor (0x005761d8).

0x0078D8F4.name: g_dspDefaultPeriodConstant
0x0078D8F4.comment: DSP service timing period constant (0x1B14A172) in .rodata; copied into DSP service state block (+0x1C) in maybe_Snd_InitDspTimeouts (0x001071ac).

0x0079C000.name: g_gfxIpcCommandRingBuffer
0x0079C000.comment: 4096-byte (0x1000) circular command ring buffer in .data for GPU and sound IPC message dispatch; processed per-frame in maybe_Gfx_ProcessFrame (0x00113a50).

0x007AEA00.name: g_dspServiceState

0x007AEA10.name: g_dspServiceMutex

0x007AEA18.name: g_dspServiceHandle
0x007AEA18.comment: IPC session handle for 3DS 'dsp::DSP' service in .data; populated by srvGetServiceHandle in Snd_OpenDspService (0x00107024) and closed via svcCloseHandle during shutdown.

0x007AEAB4.name: g_sharedServiceSessionIsOpen
0x007AEAB4.comment: Single-byte status flag in .data indicating whether shared service session is open; set to 1 in FUN_001074AC and cleared to 0 in Os_CheckHandleClosed (0x00107470).

0x007AF0A0.name: g_gpuSessionClosingFlag
0x007AF0A0.comment: Shutdown status flag in .data for GPU session; cleared to 0 upon session initialization (0x0010d6cc) and set to 1 during session teardown in Svc_CloseSessionHandles (0x0011f764).

0x007AF0B4.name: g_gpuSessionEvent
0x007AF0B4.comment: LightEvent synchronization object in .data used to synchronize GPU worker thread; initialized with ResetType 1 in maybe_Os_OpenServiceHandle (0x0010d6cc).

0x007AF0BC.name: g_aptSessionDesc
0x007AF0BC.comment: 12-byte IPC session descriptor in .data for 3DS 'APT:A' (applet service); +0x00 open flag, +0x04 pointer to "APT:A" (0x0078C44C), and +0x08 session handle.

0x007AF0C8.name: g_schedulerLockSavedPriority
0x007AF0C8.comment: Thread priority value saved prior to acquiring scheduler/GPU lock; restored via svcSetThreadPriority (svc 0x14) in Os_UnlockScheduler (0x00119e1c).

0x007AF0EC.name: g_cfgServiceLock
0x007AF0EC.comment: Monitor and reference counter block in .data for 3DS 'cfg:u' service; +0x08 tracks active users in Svc_Cfg_AcquireService (0x00112050) and Svc_Cfg_ReleaseService (0x0011212c).

0x007AF0F8.name: g_cfgServiceHandle
0x007AF0F8.comment: Active IPC session handle in .data for 3DS 'cfg:u' (configuration service); opened by Svc_Cfg_AcquireService (0x00112050) and closed by Svc_Cfg_ReleaseService (0x0011212c).

0x007AF8D0.name: g_osMemoryManagerLock
0x007AF8D0.comment: Critical section lock object in .data guarding system memory manager; +0x04 ownership flag and +0x00 lock recursion depth queried by maybe_Os_GetLockDepth (0x00106f04).

0x007AF8E0.name: g_tlsDestructorSlotMask
0x007AF8E0.comment: 16-bit bitmask in .data (init 0xFFFF0000) indicating which of the 16 thread-local storage destructor slots at 0x007EF378 are registered; tested in Os_RunTlsDestructors (0x001181b8).

0x007AF8E4.name: g_addressArbiterHandle
0x007AF8E4.comment: Kernel handle in .data for process address arbiter; created via svcCreateAddressArbiter (svc 0x21) in FUN_00106EC8 and passed to svcArbitrateAddress in synchronization primitives.

0x007AF8F8.name: g_srvClientState
0x007AF8F8.comment: 8-byte SRV client session descriptor in .data (+0x00 ready flag, +0x04 reference count); checked in Os_WaitRuntimeReady (0x00113430) and decremented in maybe_Os_ReleaseSharedHandle (0x00123260).

0x007AF900.name: g_srvSessionHandle
0x007AF900.comment: Active IPC session handle in .data for 3DS Service Manager ('srv:'); used across kernel wrappers to query service ports and closed on final release in maybe_Os_ReleaseSharedHandle (0x00123260).

0x007B0060.name: g_cfgIServiceRefCount
0x007B0060.comment: Reference count in .data of active users of 3DS 'cfg:i' service; incremented in Svc_Cfg_OpenServiceI (0x001183a4) and decremented in Svc_Cfg_CloseServiceI (0x00118288).

0x007B0064.name: g_cfgSServiceState
0x007B0064.comment: 8-byte session descriptor in .data for 3DS 'cfg:s' service (+0x00 open flag, +0x04 user refcount); updated in Svc_Cfg_OpenServiceS (0x001182fc) and Svc_Cfg_CloseServiceS (0x0011820c).

0x007B00B8.name: g_frameTickThreshold
0x007B00B8.comment: 64-bit system tick threshold (u32[2]) in .data; compared against elapsed system tick delta from svcGetSystemTick (svc 0x28) in maybe_Os_ComputeDeadline (0x0011df50).

0x007B2C9C.name: g_linearHeapPhysDelta
0x007B2C9C.comment: Physical address translation offset table in .data (+0x00 linear heap physical delta added in Os_TranslateLinearAddress, +0x04 main RAM physical delta added in Os_TranslateMainRamAddress).

0x007B2CF8.name: g_cfgIServiceHandle
0x007B2CF8.comment: Active IPC session handle in .data for 3DS 'cfg:i' (internal configuration); opened by Svc_Cfg_OpenServiceI (0x001183a4) and closed by Svc_Cfg_CloseServiceI (0x00118288).

0x007B2CFC.name: g_cfgSServiceHandle
0x007B2CFC.comment: Active IPC session handle in .data for 3DS 'cfg:s' (secure configuration); opened by Svc_Cfg_OpenServiceS (0x001182fc) and closed by Svc_Cfg_CloseServiceS (0x0011820c).

0x007B2D2C.name: g_gspGpuServiceHandle
0x007B2D2C.comment: Active IPC session handle in .data for 3DS 'gsp::Gpu' service; used to send GPU commands and register interrupts via svcSendSyncRequest across Gfx_IpcCmd20000..90000 (0x00117ab8..0x00117b44).

0x007E793C.name: g_osCallbackListLock
0x007E793C.comment: Synchronization monitor lock in .bss guarding global ordered callback list at 0x007AE954; passed to 0x00117E50/0x00117ed0 in Os_ListRemoveNodeIfPresent (0x0010cc30) and maybe_Os_InsertListNodeByKey (0x0010ccb0).

0x007E7978.name: g_dspEventHandles
0x007E7978.comment: Array of 8 event/wait synchronization handles in .bss (32 bytes); validated in maybe_Os_WaitSyncObject (0x00107100) and closed during shutdown in maybe_Os_ShutdownSyncObject (0x00107208).

0x007E79B8.name: g_dspShutdownCallbacks
0x007E79B8.comment: Array of 8 finalizer function pointers in .bss (32 bytes) for DSP service; registered/cleared in Snd_OpenDspService (0x00107024) and invoked in maybe_Os_CallFinalizers (0x0011233c).

0x007E79D8.name: g_dspServiceListNode
0x007E79D8.comment: Intrusive doubly-linked list node descriptor in .bss (20 bytes) for DSP service; linked into global ordered list 0x007AE954 in Snd_OpenDspService (0x00107024) and unlinked in shutdown (0x00107208).

0x007EDFA4.name: g_gpuSessionHandles
0x007EDFA4.comment: Array of 3 kernel object handles in .bss (12 bytes) for GPU worker thread; populated in maybe_Os_OpenServiceHandle (0x0010d6cc) and closed via svcCloseHandle in Svc_CloseSessionHandles (0x0011f764).

0x007EF0A4.name: g_osSystemMonitor
0x007EF0A4.comment: Global system lock/monitor object in .bss; initialized once via FUN_00111E28 under atomic one-shot flag in Os_InitializeOnce (0x00118454) and returned as singleton lock.

0x007EF360.name: g_memMappedBlockAllocator
0x007EF360.comment: Virtual address range allocator in .bss for memory block mapping; manages address ranges for svcMapMemoryBlock in Mem_MapPages (0x0011e720) and frees them in Os_CloseHandleAndUnlink (0x00111e44).

0x007EF378.name: g_tlsDestructors
0x007EF378.comment: Array of 16 thread-local storage destructor function pointers in .bss (64 bytes); iterated and invoked for active slots in Os_RunTlsDestructors (0x001181b8) before thread termination.

0x007F2358.name: g_srvNotificationManager
0x007F2358.comment: State block in .bss for service notification worker; contains session handle (+0x0C), worker thread object (+0x10), registered client list head (+0x18), and monitor lock (+0x1C).

0x007F2630.name: g_osResourceCapabilityConfig
0x007F2630.comment: 40-byte capability and resource limits descriptor table in .bss; initialized with early-boot resource limit attributes (0x87, 8, 10, 2, etc.) in maybe_Os_InitExclusiveAccessTable (0x0067aab8).

0x007F2C7C.name: g_paramBlockChecksum
0x007F2C7C.comment: Single-byte CRC checksum accumulator in .bss; reset to 0 and populated with 15-byte checksum in maybe_Os_ScanParamBlocks (0x0011e0dc) to verify parameter entry header integrity.

0x007F2DA0.name: g_paramBlockBuffer
0x007F2DA0.comment: 64-byte (0x40) parameter block buffer in .bss; populated by chunked table reader FUN_001223B0 in maybe_Os_LookupParamEntry (0x001179c0) to parse four 16-byte entries.

0x0077F6C4.name: g_fsResourceVtable
0x0077F6C4.comment: Virtual method table (12 slots) for Fs_Resource; slot 0 is destructor thunk 0x005F9518 (releasing pack handle at +0x3C), slot 7 is Fs_Resource_SetupPathAndHandle (0x005F8FB8), slot 9 is Fs_Resource_Release (0x005F9130), and slot 11 is Fs_BuildBg2DResourceName (0x005F9330).

0x007824A4.name: g_fsWorkerVtable
0x007824A4.comment: Two-part virtual method table (primary at +0x00, secondary interface at +0x18) for Fs_Worker; slot 0 is complete destructor Fs_Worker_Dtor (0x0056FF4C), slot 3 is Fs_Worker_ProcessQueue (0x0056FDD0), and secondary slot 1 (+0x1C) is Fs_Worker_DtorThunkA (0x0066D90C); installed in Pack_HandleEntry_Init and restored in Fs_Worker_Dtor.

0x00782A6C.name: g_packHandleTableVtable
0x00782A6C.comment: Two-part virtual method table (primary at +0x00, secondary interface at +0x18) for PackHandleTable; slot 3 is Fs_Worker_ProcessQueue (0x0056FDD0) and secondary slot 1 (+0x1C) is Fs_Worker_DtorThunkB (0x0066D95C); installed into the singleton instance during Pack_HandleTable_Get (0x0010AF94).

0x007A62DC.name: g_packEffectLoadTable
0x007A62DC.comment: Table of 7 effect pack archive descriptors in .data (56 bytes, 14 words: each entry is {char* path, u32 loadMode}); indexed by slot index in Pack_HandleTable_Acquire (0x003606BC) to load battle, common, field, minigame, fullmenu, smith, and dive effect packs.

0x007BE364.name: g_packHandleTableInitGuard
0x007BE364.comment: One-shot initialization guard flag (1 byte in .data, initialized to 1) for the PackHandleTable singleton; checked and cleared to 0 on first invocation of Pack_HandleTable_Get (0x0010AF94) or Pack_FreeHandleEntry (0x001241D0) before constructing the table.

0x007BE368.name: g_packHandleTable
0x007BE368.comment: Global singleton pointer to the lazily initialized PackHandleTable instance; populated by Pack_HandleTable_Get (0x0010AF94) or Pack_FreeHandleEntry (0x001241D0) with the address of the constructed buffer at 0x008342B0.

0x008342B0.name: g_packHandleTableBuffer
0x008342B0.comment: Static BSS memory buffer (11,364 / 0x2C64 bytes, aligned to 16 bytes) providing placement storage for the PackHandleTable singleton object; zero-cleared with memset (0x00116AE0) and constructed via Pack_HandleEntry_Init (0x001242AC) in Pack_HandleTable_Get.

0x00728A54.name: g_partyMemberJoinTable
0x00728A54.comment: Table of 8 playable party member join records (4 bytes each: u8 charaId, u8 pad, u16 saveFlagOffset) for the 8 main story characters (1 Hero, 2 Erik, 3 Veronica, 0x1B Serena, 4 Sylvando, 5 Rab, 6 Jade, 7 Hendrik). Used by PartyAdd to look up story recruitment flags (0x0145..0x014C) at (work+0x24A98)+0x2A70 and synchronize party roster.

0x0072A5F8.name: g_partyAutoHealDefaultAction
0x0072A5F8.comment: Default sentinel action decision record (8 bytes: u8 actorIdx=0xFF, u8 targetIdx=0xFF, u8 skillId=0xFF, u8 unk=0xFF, u8 status=0x00, u8 flags=0x00, u16 unk=0xFFFF) for party auto-heal ('Mantan' / まんたん). Copied onto stack at entry of Party Auto-Heal evaluator (0x0046EE3C) and returned to Ui_SakusenWindow when no further healing action is needed or available.

0x00754FC8.name: g_regexPredefinedClassRangeTable
0x00754FC8.comment: Master lookup table of 2,574 Unicode code-point ranges used by regex predefined character classes (POSIX classes and Unicode script/block names such as \p{Lower}, \p{ASCII}, \p{InGreek}). Each 4-byte entry encodes a {u16 start, u16 end} code-point interval inserted into a character set by Regex_Set_AddPredefinedClass.

0x00757800.name: g_regexPredefinedClassDescriptorTable
0x00757800.comment: Descriptor slice table for the 132 predefined regex character classes (class IDs 0..0x83). Each 8-byte entry stores a {u32 firstRangeIndex, u32 rangeCount} pair indexing the range runs in g_regexPredefinedClassRangeTable (0x00754FC8).

0x00757C20.name: g_regexPredefinedClassNameTable
0x00757C20.comment: Name lookup table for the 132 predefined regex character classes matched by Regex_ParsePredefinedClass when parsing '\p{Name}' or '\P{Name}'. Each 8-byte entry contains {const wchar_t* nameWithBrace, u32 length} (e.g. 'Lower}', 'Upper}', 'ASCII}', 'InLatin-1Supplement}').

0x007AF1B0.name: g_regexOpcodeDispatchTable
0x007AF1B0.comment: Regex pattern VM opcode dispatch table in .data containing 38 8-byte {void* handler, u32 flagsOrCtxOffset} entries split into two 19-opcode parallel sub-tables: match handlers at +0x00..+0x90 and advance handlers at +0x98..+0x128, dispatched by maybe_Regex_MatchLoop and Regex_MatchSequence.

0x007250BC.name: g_senrekiCompletedFlagIdsA
0x007250BC.comment: Flag-id table A for the 'senreki' (play-record) completion counter: 10 groups of 4 u16 save-progress flag ids. Save_Senreki_CountCompletedFlagsA copies it to the stack and counts a group when any of its four flag bits is set in the save flag bitmask at saveData+0x4B30.

0x0072514C.name: g_senrekiCompletedFlagIdsE
0x0072514C.comment: Flag-id table E for the 'senreki' (play-record) completion counter: 12 groups of 4 u16 save-progress flag ids tested against the save flag bitmask at saveData+0x4B30.

0x007251AC.name: g_senrekiCompletedFlagIdsB
0x007251AC.comment: Flag-id table B for the 'senreki' (play-record) completion counter: 14 groups of 4 u16 save-progress flag ids tested against the save flag bitmask at saveData+0x4B30.

0x0072521C.name: g_senrekiCompletedFlagIdsC
0x0072521C.comment: Flag-id table C for the 'senreki' (play-record) completion counter: 9 groups of 4 u16 save-progress flag ids tested against the save flag bitmask at saveData+0x4B30.

0x007252A4.name: g_senrekiCompletedFlagIdsD
0x007252A4.comment: Flag-id table D for the 'senreki' (play-record) completion counter: 14 groups of 4 u16 save-progress flag ids tested against the save flag bitmask at saveData+0x4B30.

0x007288C8.name: g_saveMemberPresenceOffsets
0x007288C8.comment: Seven {u16 partySlot, u16 presentByteOffset} pairs telling the save loader which party slots have a stored character record: for slots 1..6 the loader tests the byte at save block (work+0x24A98) + 0x2A70 + offset (0x145,0x146,0x147,0x149,0x14A,0x14B); slot 0 is special-cased (pair {0,0xFFFF}) and always applied.

0x0072D76C.name: g_saveDataLimits
0x0072D76C.comment: Save-data limit/descriptor record: word 0 = 9,999,999 (gold/value clamp), +0x04 = 99 (level cap), +0x08 = 255 (byte/count cap), +0x0C = default 4-byte-entry init function 0x00611FF4 (writes 0xFFFF/0), +0x10 = dispatch flags (0). Ui_DataPanel_WriteItemInfoToBuffer clamps a value against word 0, and maybe_Save_BuildSectionList dispatches through +0xC/+0x10.

0x0072D780.name: g_saveDataMountName
0x0072D780.comment: Inline mount/device name 'data:' at the head of the save-data archive descriptor; six 8-byte path-formatter method slots follow at +0x08..+0x37 (system / Data%d / mini_%d, repeated twice). Passed to Fs_UnmountByName and Svc_ContentObject_GetSharedHandle as the mount name and used as the '%s' root when building save-file paths.

0x0072D7A0.name: g_saveArchiveSystemPathMethod
0x0072D7A0.comment: One 8-byte ARM pointer-to-member-function slot {formatter 0x002CE46C, this-adjust 0} inside the save-archive descriptor's formatter table (entry 4 of 6, +0x20). The target tail-calls the vsnprintf wrapper with format '%s/system' and root 'data:', producing the archive's system file path.

0x0072D7B0.name: g_saveArchiveMiniPathMethod
0x0072D7B0.comment: One 8-byte ARM pointer-to-member-function slot {Fs_FormatMiniPath 0x002CE660, this-adjust 0} inside the save-archive descriptor's formatter table (entry 6 of 6, +0x30). It builds the archive's 'mini' slot-record path '%s/mini_%d' and is used for the second save string block and for loading slot records.

0x0072D8F4.name: g_saveCryptoBlowfishInitP
0x0072D8F4.comment: Default Blowfish P-array (18 subkeys) for the save-data cipher: Save_Crypto_ExpandKey copies it (0x48 bytes) to the stack, XORs the user key into it, then runs the nine encrypt rounds that rebuild the schedule. Initial word 0x243F6A88 is the first hex digit of pi, the standard Blowfish P[0].

0x0072D93C.name: g_saveCryptoBlowfishInitS
0x0072D93C.comment: Default Blowfish S-boxes for the save-data cipher: four boxes of 256 u32 subkeys copied by Save_Crypto_ExpandKey (0x1000 bytes) and then re-keyed with the running encrypted block, 256 words per box. Initial word 0xD1310BA6 is the standard Blowfish S0[0].

0x0072E93C.name: g_saveCryptoCrc16Table
0x0072E93C.comment: 256-entry CRC-16 lookup table for the save-data integrity check: Save_Crypto_Context_Init copies the 512 bytes to ctx+0x1058 and the MAC helper 0x005F07A4 indexes it as u16[256]. First entries are 0x0000 and 0xC0C1, the reflected CRC-16/IBM (ARC) table; SealBlock/OpenBlock compare the inverted 16-bit result over 11 bytes.

0x0075CCA0.name: g_fieldObject2DSharedVtable
0x0075CCA0.comment: Shared base vtable for the 2-D field-object class: Field_Object2D_CtorA runs the actor base constructor and installs this table before the concrete factory vtable (0x77xxxx) replaces it. Slots are 0x002658FC (complete destructor), 0x002658D0, 0x001FEFC0 and 0x001F96D4.

0x00780B20.name: g_saveSlotPanelVtable
0x00780B20.comment: Vtable of the save-slot UI panel object built by maybe_Save_SlotUi_Ctor: word 0 is the complete destructor 0x0045E700, words 1-5 are null, and the Ui widget interface at +0x18 holds Ui_WidgetGroup_DispatchUpdate (0x001A5EE0), Ui_Widget_DispatchActiveChildren (0x001A5DC0), Ui_WidgetGroup_DispatchUpdate (0x001A5D4C), Ui_MessagePage_Update (0x004A6810) and 0x001DAA20.

0x00780D20.name: maybe_g_fsArchiveEntryEmptyTemplate
0x00780D20.comment: Static 16-byte template used to initialise stack Fs archive/file objects: word 0 and word 3 are the vtable 0x00780D60 (which carries Fs_ArchiveEntry_Seek at +0xC and Fs_ArchiveEntry_ReadAt at +0x20), words 1-2 are the secondary interface pointer 0x0072D7E8. Functions copy it into a local before Fs_SplitResourceName / Fs_ArchiveEntry_ReadInto.

0x00780F84.name: maybe_g_rodata_780F84
0x00780F84.comment: Zero-initialised 4-byte rodata word loaded by the GPU-channel/Save_AsyncReadWorker thread (0x001170CC) and stored into the thread's local request structure at [sp+4] just before the 6-byte record copy; no reader or writer resolves its meaning, so the name is deliberately left as an address placeholder.

0x007842B8.name: g_saveCryptoContextVtable
0x007842B8.comment: Vtable of the save-data crypt context: installed at *ctx by Save_CryptoContext_Destroy. Seven words: complete destructor 0x005EF028, two header words (0), deleting destructor 0x005EF00C, shared stubs 0x00669AE0 / 0x00669AE8, and 0x005EF328. It has exactly the same layout as the neighbouring MoLive filter vtables at 0x00784294.

0x007A7114.name: maybe_g_saveValidateItemRecords
0x007A7114.comment: Retail-disabled validation switch in the save-record loader: when non-zero, maybe_Save_ApplyRecordToWork walks the record's stored item-id lists and calls Item_LookupRecord for every id; in the retail image the byte is 0 and the lookups are skipped.

0x007B0082.name: g_gpuChannelStatusByte2
0x007B0082.comment: Third byte of the GPU-channel work/status word at 0x007B0080: Gfx_OpenGpuChannel clears it when starting the channel, and the channel worker thread (0x001170CC) stores a decoded record byte there after a successful read. Part of the same little-endian u32 that G_022 named g_gpuChannelStatus.

0x007B0086.name: g_gpuChannelIpcCommandBuffer
0x007B0086.comment: Three-byte IPC command buffer at GPU-channel work+6: Gfx_OpenGpuChannel copies the channel configuration bytes (0x100 / device bytes) into it, and the channel worker sends the three bytes with func_001228A8(&g_gpuChannelIpcCommandBuffer, 3) (Os_IpcSendCommand0D/0E).

0x007B0090.name: g_gpuChannelTimeoutRemaining
0x007B0090.comment: Fraction of the GPU-channel wait timeout still remaining: initialised to 1.0f, recomputed by maybe_Os_ComputeDeadline as 1.0 - elapsed/total from the system tick and clamped at 0. The worker at 0x001170CC passes its address as the 'now' value while polling for the channel response.

0x0072EF3C.name: g_saveCodeAlphabet
0x0072EF3C.comment: Canonical 64-character Japanese Hiragana alphabet table (128 bytes, UTF-16LE) used for Spell of Restoration (Fukkatsu no Jumon); maps 6-bit values (0..63) to/from Japanese syllabary characters (44 basic hiragana plus 20 voiced kana: ga, za, da, ba); used by SaveCode_Decode, SaveCode_Encode, and SaveCode_ValidateChar.

0x0072F1C0.name: g_saveCodeCheckDigitWeights
0x0072F1C0.comment: Array of 6 double-precision probability weights (48 bytes: 0.1, 5e-5, 0.001, 0.1, 0.05, 0.001) used by SaveCode_GenerateCheckDigits to accumulate cumulative thresholds for weighted random selection of 5 check digits from 100 candidate slots.

0x0072F1F0.name: g_saveCodeFixed20InputAlphabet
